display.description: Workers that have an established IPsec tunnel to the NAS.
display.name: Tunnels up

display.description: Workers that report no tunnel. Anything above 0 needs attention.
display.name: Tunnels down

display.description: Workers whose ipsec-nas-metrics pod is being scraped.
display.name: Workers reporting

display.description: Days until the first node certificate expires. cert-manager renews 30 days before expiry.
display.name: Soonest certificate expiry

display.description: UP when the node has an established tunnel to the NAS.
display.name: Tunnel state per node

display.description: From the certificate in each node's NSS database, which is what libreswan actually uses.
display.name: Certificate days left per node

display.description: Bytes per second sent to and received from the NAS through IPsec. NFS traffic shows up here.
display.name: Traffic through the tunnel

display.description: Time since the current tunnel was established. A small value on one node means it was re-established recently.
display.name: Tunnel age per node

display.description: Time since the collector last ran. More than 5 minutes means the collector container stopped.
display.name: Metrics age per node

display.description: The libreswan version installed on each node.
display.name: libreswan version per node

display.description: Which option put the certificate on each node: B (cert-sync), C (wildcard MachineConfig) or A (shared MachineConfig). A node with none of their markers shows nothing.
display.name: Certificate source per node

display.description: Nodes with more than one ipsec-nas-metrics pod reporting (alert IpsecNasDuplicateNode). Must be 0.
display.name: Nodes reported twice

display.description: Pods whose node label differs from the node Kubernetes placed them on (alert IpsecNasNodeLabelMismatch). Must be 0.
display.name: Pods reporting the wrong node

display.description: Packets the kernel IPsec code dropped in the last hour, over every selected node: the sum of the counters in /proc/net/xfrm_stat, each of which counts drops for one reason.
display.name: Kernel IPsec errors, last hour

display.description: One row per node. Why a tunnel is down: no certificate, no connection (NNCP), no IKE SA, or libreswan not answering. NFS requests/s comes from the platform's node-exporter. The reporting pod and the NAS identity of each node whose tunnel is up are in the table below.
display.name: Per node

spec.query: sum by (node) (label_replace(rate(node_nfs_requests_total{instance=~"$node"}[5m]), "node", "$1", "instance", "(.*)")) and on (node) max by (node) (ipsec_nas_collect_timestamp_seconds{node=~"$node"})

display.description: How often each node's tunnel was set up again. Above 3 fires IpsecNasTunnelFlapping: a tunnel that keeps restarting looks up on the other panels.
display.name: Tunnel re-establishments in the last hour

display.description: Rate of the error counters in /proc/net/xfrm_stat, by counter. Lines appear only for counters that moved.
display.name: Kernel IPsec errors per node

display.description: Namespaces with at least one claim whose volume the NFS CSI driver (nfs.csi.k8s.io) made. The NAS IP of each is in the table below.
display.name: Namespaces using the NAS

spec.query: count(count by (namespace) (max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim, storageclass, volumename) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info) * on (volumename) group_left (nas_ip, export, directory, reclaim_policy) max by (volumename, nas_ip, export, directory, reclaim_policy) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_persistentvolume_info{csi_driver="nfs.csi.k8s.io"}, "nas_ip", "$1", "csi_volume_handle", "([^#]*)#.*"), "export", "/$1", "csi_volume_handle", "[^#]*#([^#]*)#.*"), "directory", "$1", "csi_volume_handle", "[^#]*#[^#]*#([^#]*)#.*"), "volumename", "$1", "persistentvolume", "(.*)")))) or vector(0)

display.description: Claims whose volume the NFS CSI driver made, in all namespaces.
display.name: Claims on the NAS

spec.query: count(max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim, storageclass, volumename) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info) * on (volumename) group_left (nas_ip, export, directory, reclaim_policy) max by (volumename, nas_ip, export, directory, reclaim_policy) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_persistentvolume_info{csi_driver="nfs.csi.k8s.io"}, "nas_ip", "$1", "csi_volume_handle", "([^#]*)#.*"), "export", "/$1", "csi_volume_handle", "[^#]*#([^#]*)#.*"), "directory", "$1", "csi_volume_handle", "[^#]*#[^#]*#([^#]*)#.*"), "volumename", "$1", "persistentvolume", "(.*)"))) or vector(0)

display.description: Claims of a StorageClass of the NFS CSI driver that are not Bound (Pending: the driver could not create the directory, or cannot reach the NAS). Must be 0.
display.name: Claims not Bound

spec.query: count(max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_status_phase{phase!="Bound"} == 1) and on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim, storageclass) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info) * on (storageclass) group_left () max by (storageclass) (kube_storageclass_info{provisioner="nfs.csi.k8s.io"}))) or vector(0)

display.description: Pods that mount a NAS claim on a node whose tunnel is down, or whose node has no collector reporting it. Their NFS cannot reach an IPsec-only NAS. Must be 0.
display.name: NAS pods without a working tunnel

spec.query: count(((0 * (max by (namespace, pod, persistentvolumeclaim) (kube_pod_spec_volumes_persistentvolumeclaims_info) * on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_left (nas_ip, export) max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim, nas_ip, export) (max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim, storageclass, volumename) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info) * on (volumename) group_left (nas_ip, export, directory, reclaim_policy) max by (volumename, nas_ip, export, directory, reclaim_policy) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_persistentvolume_info{csi_driver="nfs.csi.k8s.io"}, "nas_ip", "$1", "csi_volume_handle", "([^#]*)#.*"), "export", "/$1", "csi_volume_handle", "[^#]*#([^#]*)#.*"), "directory", "$1", "csi_volume_handle", "[^#]*#[^#]*#([^#]*)#.*"), "volumename", "$1", "persistentvolume", "(.*)"))) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{node=~"$node"})) + on (node) group_left () max by (node) (ipsec_nas_tunnel_up)) or (0 * (max by (namespace, pod, persistentvolumeclaim) (kube_pod_spec_volumes_persistentvolumeclaims_info) * on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_left (nas_ip, export) max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim, nas_ip, export) (max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim, storageclass, volumename) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info) * on (volumename) group_left (nas_ip, export, directory, reclaim_policy) max by (volumename, nas_ip, export, directory, reclaim_policy) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_persistentvolume_info{csi_driver="nfs.csi.k8s.io"}, "nas_ip", "$1", "csi_volume_handle", "([^#]*)#.*"), "export", "/$1", "csi_volume_handle", "[^#]*#([^#]*)#.*"), "directory", "$1", "csi_volume_handle", "[^#]*#[^#]*#([^#]*)#.*"), "volumename", "$1", "persistentvolume", "(.*)"))) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{node=~"$node"})) - 1)) < 1) or vector(0)

display.description: Each claim whose volume the NFS CSI driver made: where it lives on the NAS (taken from the volume's handle) and what deleting the claim does to the volume (reclaim policy; what happens to the data is the class's onDelete).
display.name: Claims on the NAS

spec.query: (max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim, storageclass, volumename) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info) * on (volumename) group_left (nas_ip, export, directory, reclaim_policy) max by (volumename, nas_ip, export, directory, reclaim_policy) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_persistentvolume_info{csi_driver="nfs.csi.k8s.io"}, "nas_ip", "$1", "csi_volume_handle", "([^#]*)#.*"), "export", "/$1", "csi_volume_handle", "[^#]*#([^#]*)#.*"), "directory", "$1", "csi_volume_handle", "[^#]*#[^#]*#([^#]*)#.*"), "volumename", "$1", "persistentvolume", "(.*)"))) * on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_left (phase) max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim, phase) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_status_phase == 1)

display.description: Each pod that mounts a NAS claim, the node it runs on, and that node's IPsec tunnel: UP, DOWN, or NO COLLECTOR (no pod of the collector reports the node, so its tunnel is not watched). The node filter applies here.
display.name: Pods using NAS claims, and their node's tunnel

spec.query: (0 * (max by (namespace, pod, persistentvolumeclaim) (kube_pod_spec_volumes_persistentvolumeclaims_info) * on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_left (nas_ip, export) max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim, nas_ip, export) (max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim, storageclass, volumename) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info) * on (volumename) group_left (nas_ip, export, directory, reclaim_policy) max by (volumename, nas_ip, export, directory, reclaim_policy) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_persistentvolume_info{csi_driver="nfs.csi.k8s.io"}, "nas_ip", "$1", "csi_volume_handle", "([^#]*)#.*"), "export", "/$1", "csi_volume_handle", "[^#]*#([^#]*)#.*"), "directory", "$1", "csi_volume_handle", "[^#]*#[^#]*#([^#]*)#.*"), "volumename", "$1", "persistentvolume", "(.*)"))) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{node=~"$node"})) + on (node) group_left () max by (node) (ipsec_nas_tunnel_up)) or (0 * (max by (namespace, pod, persistentvolumeclaim) (kube_pod_spec_volumes_persistentvolumeclaims_info) * on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_left (nas_ip, export) max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim, nas_ip, export) (max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim, storageclass, volumename) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info) * on (volumename) group_left (nas_ip, export, directory, reclaim_policy) max by (volumename, nas_ip, export, directory, reclaim_policy) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_persistentvolume_info{csi_driver="nfs.csi.k8s.io"}, "nas_ip", "$1", "csi_volume_handle", "([^#]*)#.*"), "export", "/$1", "csi_volume_handle", "[^#]*#([^#]*)#.*"), "directory", "$1", "csi_volume_handle", "[^#]*#[^#]*#([^#]*)#.*"), "volumename", "$1", "persistentvolume", "(.*)"))) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{node=~"$node"})) - 1)

display.description: The identity the NAS presented, from its certificate, and the ipsec-nas-metrics pod that reports the node. A node with no tunnel has no row here. A node in two rows is reported by two pods.
display.name: NAS identity per node
